## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      3 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 7 may 2026 - 15 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios reportan problemas de fiabilidad. Apunta a gaps de calidad que un competidor puede explotar.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _plantguyhome_, 28 may 2026, 1/5: "I was so excited to use this app, even considered premium, but sadly my data gets lost every time after exiting the app for a while. This means everything is gone and I just get an apology over and over. For an app that’s meant to help people (especially ones with special conditions) this felt really frustrating to me and really killed my energy yesterday, as it has happened multiple times just yesterday. If I hatch a new pet I DON’T get the promised 500 currency + the data gets lost again. 🫤 UPDATE: Now I can’t even hatch a new egg, because the App just turns grey. Whenever I try to access the old data the screen goes white for an infinite time. So I can neither log in nor create a new one. It’s just completely broken on Iphone ig."
            2. _I hate. Finch_, 9 jul 2026, 2/5: "Finch is bad because it I so slow"
            3. _wolkenflauschig_, 7 may 2026, 4/5: "app is crashing more often lately :("

## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 18 jul 2026 - 18 jul 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Mr. T-Wrecks_, 18 jul 2026, 3/5: "I like the app. It has helped me stay focused and productive throughout the day. The only thing that really bothers me is the Shop items. If you’re a Free user, you only get 8 options in Outfit and Furniture to choose from (16 with the free re-roll). But the options are the worst options—they’re typically the most boring/generic options, and they follow the same pattern every time. All the good options require Finch Plus. Why? Free users are earning the same points in the same way as any user on Finch Plus. The items are already behind one “paywall” (in-game currency”). Why put them behind two?"
